Class Graph

java.lang.Object
Graph
All Implemented Interfaces:
GraphInterface<Town,Road>
public class Graph extends Object implements GraphInterface<Town,Road>
A Graph implementation that manages Town vertices and Road edges. Supports adding/removing towns and roads, querying edges/vertices, and computing shortest paths using Dijkstra's algorithm.
Version:
5/10/25
